stories.title: Law on 'holiday hunger' passed by Stormont assembly
stories.summary: A majority of 49 to 24 assembly members backed the legislation, which was proposed by Sinn Féin's Danny Baker and welcomed by some parents and charities.

stories.title: Cattle cull was lawful but there were operational shortcomings, review finds
stories.summary: Ireland's former chief veterinary officer Dr Martin Blake carried out a review of the operation.

stories.title: Arrests made after visit from former US President Biden
stories.summary: Joe Biden was in Dublin to see his son Hunter awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse

stories.title: Jury discharged in Chloe Mitchell murder trial
stories.summary: The judge has given no reasons for the decision but said he will give his reasons in due course, after the conclusion of the trial.

stories.title: Man left 'traumatised' after racist attack
stories.summary: Police are treating three assaults on Sunday night as racially-motivated hate crimes.

stories.title: Some pupils 'struggling just to get a hot meal'
stories.summary: Students speak out as school dinner prices are set to increase for the second time in a year.

stories.title: New law could stop killers' parental rights in NI
stories.summary: The proposed changes to family law are being considered in a public consultation, which was launched on Tuesday.

stories.title: Woman aged in her 80s dies in hospital after crash
stories.summary: The woman was struck by a vehicle in the Circular Road area of Newtownards last week.

stories.title: 'Blatant disrespect' - Row over DUP bid to veto Irish education bill
stories.summary: Sinn Féin accuses the DUP of "sectarianism" but the DUP says its move is in response to Drumcree.

stories.title: New regulation for heating oil market, but no price controls
stories.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority has investigated the heating oil market in Northern Ireland and other parts of the UK.

stories.title: To the day I die, I will regret putting a cigarette in my mouth
stories.summary: Joan McConville is calling for a national screening programme in Northern Ireland, like there is in England and Wales.

stories.title: Residents appeal over street light removal
stories.summary: Almost a hundred families will be affected by the loss of the streetlights.
